verdict.rationale: Epic documents official programming surfaces to build against: the C++ gameplay API with reflection and delegates, an official Unreal Python API with a generated per-class reference and IDE autocomplete stubs, and the Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API, which can call any Blueprint-callable function. However, the Python API is marked Experimental, source access is EULA/account-gated, and no official packaged client SDKs exist for external consumers of the Remote Control API. missing for 10: stable (non-experimental) Python API, official client-language SDK libraries for the Remote Control API, keyless agent-friendly access to source/SDK artifacts, independent hands-on corroboration.
